summary: Coverage ladder connecting roadmap organisms to runtime-supported atom sequences, preview fixture evidence, and remaining blockers. This artifact is advisory and does not promote organism names to public capabilities.

coverage_tiers.meaning: At least one representative organism preview runs through workbookcase using supported atoms and operation-specific verifiers.
The organism can be decomposed into currently supported atoms, but no organism preview fixture proves the composition yet.
The organism depends on at least one planned atom that is intentionally outside the supported runtime registry.
The organism remains useful as a research hint, but its core workbook behavior lacks a supported atom sequence.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative invoice row input, calculation, validation, formula protection, and printable form materialization are executable.
remaining_gaps: supplier/customer lookup enrichment is supported but not in this preview
full document layout inference is not supported
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Add an organism-level verifier that checks metadata, line totals, printable region, and protected summary in one acceptance pass.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative reimbursement row append, reimbursable formula extension, and printable claim materialization are executable.
remaining_gaps: validation and protection are supported but not in this preview
policy eligibility checks are not supported as a separate gate
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a fixture that appends expense rows, extends reimbursable totals, validates categories, protects totals, and emits a printable claim.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative purchase-order supplier lookup and status validation are executable.
remaining_gaps: line totals and printable PO generation are supported but not in this preview
multi-document receipt/invoice matching belongs to procurement reconciliation
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a PO fixture that enriches supplier metadata, appends line items, validates status, and generates a printable PO sheet.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative budget summary and over-budget threshold exception handling are executable.
remaining_gaps: period copy, roll-forward, formula extension, and protected summary are supported but not in this preview as one organism flow
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create an organism-level fixture that copies a month, carries closing values, extends formulas, highlights variance, and protects summaries.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative closing-to-opening balance continuity is executable.
remaining_gaps: full cash-flow table summarization and protected dashboard regions are not proven in one organism flow
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create an organism-level fixture that combines period copy, roll-forward, formula preservation, summary checks, and protection.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative attendance period copy, status dropdown validation, and formula protection are executable.
remaining_gaps: matrix auto-growth and calendar projection are advisory molecule gaps
header normalization is supported but not in this preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create an organism-level verifier for roster/date growth, status validation, totals, and protected helper regions.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative period sheet copy with formula preservation is executable.
remaining_gaps: row append, formula extension, validation, and protection are supported but not proven together in this organism preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a timesheet fixture that copies a period, appends hours, extends pay formulas, validates allowed fields, and protects totals.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative project timeline period copy and task status validation are executable.
remaining_gaps: timeline grid projection does not have a dedicated runtime atom
formula extension and summaries are supported but not in this preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a fixture that updates task rows and proves timeline/status summary behavior with the existing supported atom subset.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative shift roster period copy and shift-code validation are executable.
remaining_gaps: conflict detection and coverage gap projection lack dedicated organism-level verification
protected totals, header cleanup, and summary are supported but not in this preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a shift roster fixture that copies a period, validates shift codes, summarizes coverage, and protects summary formulas.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative construction cost row append and overrun threshold highlighting are executable.
remaining_gaps: earned-value style timeline projection is not supported
cumulative summary, roll-forward, and protected totals are supported but not in this preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a fixture that appends cost/change rows, summarizes actuals, flags variance, and preserves protected forecast formulas.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative inventory header normalization and stock-master reconciliation are executable.
remaining_gaps: movement row append, lookup enrichment, and protected balance formulas are supported but not in one organism preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create an organism-level fixture that appends movements, extends balance formulas, enriches SKU metadata, and reconciles stock master.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative procurement PO-to-invoice reconciliation is executable.
remaining_gaps: three-way PO/receipt/invoice reconciliation is not directly supported by one atom
normalization, status validation, protection, and summaries are supported but not in this preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a fixture that normalizes two procurement tables, reconciles keys and amounts, validates status, and protects review formulas.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative warehouse SKU enrichment and low-stock threshold highlighting are executable.
remaining_gaps: reorder quantity policy calculation is not a dedicated atom
stock append, validation, summary, and protection are supported but not in this preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a fixture that updates stock rows, joins SKU metadata, flags reorder thresholds, and protects reorder summaries.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative gradebook score summary and status validation are executable with deterministic summary sheets.
remaining_gaps: matrix growth lacks a dedicated atom
native pivot-style score distribution remains outside supported scope
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Promote or replace pivot-style summary needs, then create a gradebook fixture with score entry, formula extension, protected summaries, and distribution checks.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative training completion summary and printable reporting are executable with deterministic summary sheets.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative sales stage summary and risk threshold highlighting are executable with deterministic summary sheets.

organisms.next_promotion_gate: Define forecast summary verification, then add a pipeline fixture or promote the pivot summary atom.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative maintenance issue append and overdue threshold highlighting are executable.

status validation, protection, and summaries are supported but not in this preview
organisms.next_promotion_gate: Create a fixture that appends issues, validates status, flags overdue or high-risk rows, and summarizes open actions.

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative compliance status summary and printable reporting are executable with deterministic summary sheets.
remaining_gaps: native pivot-style compliance dashboards remain outside supported scope

organisms.coverage_claim: Representative safety risk threshold highlighting and printable reporting are executable.
remaining_gaps: native pivot-style score dashboards remain outside supported scope
